title: Scenario cards: a serif heading, a sans lede and three parallel paper cards, each with a swatch row, a bold sans title, a sans subtitle and one serif sentence
use: Three parallel scenarios, options or cases; level_1..3 set how many of each card's three swatches are in the hue.

heading.default: 可能的未来有很多，我们重点讨论三种

lede.default: 每个情景都用同一套参数生成，只改变推理需求增速和企业采用速度两项假设。

text_1.default: 推理成本下降快于需求增长，2027 年起订单回落，利润向下游应用转移。

text_2.default: 训练投入趋稳，推理接棒，资本开支保持高位但同比增速降到个位数。

text_3.default: 企业把大量流程交给智能体，推理需求每年翻倍以上，电力成为主要瓶颈。

credits.default: 撰写：研究组 · v1.0 · 2026 年 11 月 · 本页为模板示例，数据均为虚构
credits.note: italic credits with version and month

relations: Three cards 440 x 350, 24 apart, paper #F5F4ED with a 1 unit hairline and radius 8; 28 padding.
Swatches 24 units, 4 apart: the data hue for the first `level` of three, the neutral tile #D6D3C6 for the rest; hue per card: purple, blue, amber.
Title 24 sans bold, subtitle 16 sans #5E5D59, sentence 19 serif / 1.5, up to five lines.
